# Vendor STEP models

Put manufacturer / GrabCAD STEP files here with these exact names (`.step` or `.stp`). `physio_pod.py` picks them up
automatically, uses them in the collision check and the assembly renders, and warns if a part is bigger than its bay.

| File name | Part (the exact one you bought) |
|---|---|
| `bno085.step` | BNO085 breakout (7Semi Qwiic; else Adafruit 4754 or SparkFun BNO086 Qwiic) |
| `xiao_esp32s3.step` | Seeed Studio XIAO ESP32-S3 |
| `drv2605l.step` | DRV2605L haptic driver breakout (SmartElex; else Adafruit 2305) |
| `lipo_752530.step` | 500 mAh LiPo 752530 with PCM |
| `ss12d00.step` | SS-12D00 slide switch |
| `coin_motor_10mm.step` | 10 mm ERM coin vibration motor |

Check each model's licence (GrabCAD models carry the uploader's terms) before redistributing it.
